title: Managing Director Discovery and Insight
description:
About Ted

TED is on a mission to discover and spread ideas that spark imagination, embrace possibility, and catalyze impact. Our organization is devoted to curiosity, reason, wonder, and the pursuit of knowledge â without an agenda. We welcome people from every discipline and culture who seek a deeper understanding of the world and connection with others, and we invite everyone to engage with ideas and activate them in your community.

About The Audacious Project

The Audacious Project is a collaborative funding platform that invites visionary changemakers to imagine their boldest ideas to solve the worldâs most urgent challenges.

Housed at TED, the nonprofit dedicated to the belief that ideas change everything, Audacious works to surface ideas that are breathtakingly ambitious yet achievable and brings together a community of philanthropists to unlock the funding needed to make them real. Each year, Audacious selects a cohort of extraordinary leaders from around the world â visionaries with proximity to the problems they're solving, and bold plans to shift systems, lift up communities, and contribute to a healthier planet.

Since its launch in 2018, Audacious has helped to catalyze more than $8B for over 70 projects across a range of issue areas. Rooted in TED's belief that ideas can come from anywhere, Audacious focuses on the strength of the idea and the team behind it, not a fixed issue area. Funded projects span science, climate, technology, health, social safety net and justice.

Job Description

Role Description

The Managing Director, Discovery and Insight leads Audacious's global search for ambitious ideas and changemakers â finding, testing, and building the case for the ideas and leaders most worth backing each funding cycle. This role owns end-to-end curation, application, and diligence activities, ultimately leading to recommendations for the cohort of finalists selected annually.

The Managing Director's work is centered on: a strategy informed by continuous learning about systems-level impact and Audacious' unique role within it; deep collaboration with applicants, donors, and partners nurtured over time; and leadership of a strong team to sustain the work.

Each year, the Discovery and Insight team conducts a global search to identify nonprofit ideas that are:

  • Innovative and offer a unique approach to a significant problem with the potential to shift the status quo or the system they operate within
  • Proximate & Community-Oriented in leadership and decision-making structure (i.e., led by those who intimately understand the problem/opportunity, incorporating impacted communities in decision-making, led by someone who has direct experience in/with the community served)
  • Approaching an inflection point or needing a significant capital inflow to catalyze a differentiated level of impact that they havenât received support for yet (rather than support for ongoing operations)
  • Thoughtfully ambitious ideas that both inspire and convince â have an exciting, breakthrough vision (âinspireâ), clear outcomes, and evidence that the idea will have a significant and concrete impact (âconvinceâ)

Key Responsibilities

  • Set and evolve the sourcing and curation strategy.
  • Advance sourcing and curation strategy for each cycle, forming a clear point of view on where Audacious should be learning, looking, collaborating, and why, ultimately carrying that strategy forward across cycles
  • Develop a âfuture-orientedâ approach by monitoring and anticipating emerging trends and innovations that Audacious actively engages with or responds to
  • Actively capture insights and lessons learned to refine and improve Audacious's sourcing and curation activities annually
  • Lead selection and diligence.
  • Apply the sourcing and curation strategy to identify the ideas most worth Audacious's attention - deciding what advances into the application stage, and bringing along multiple stakeholders and inputs along that decision-making process
  • Lead diligence on selected organizations, rigorously testing readiness, viability, and fit within Audacious's portfolio
  • Build the recommendation â evidence, rationale, and risks included â that carries an idea into finalist selection
  • Cultivate and steward the partners who bring ideas to Audacious.
  • Surface strong ideas by building genuine, ongoing relationships with social sector leaders, including funder and intermediary partners (incl. sourcing networks, collaboratives, and others)
  • Steward key partner relationships by developing a deep understanding of each stakeholderâs goals, priorities, and aspirations
  • Maintain stakeholder relationships continuously, within and across cycles, to ensure trust and rapport among all actors
  • Represent Audacious's point of view in the field, using that standing to draw the most ambitious organizations and ideas toward the platform and to create richer opportunities for sector collaboration
  • Build and nurture a team that explores the frontier of audacious social change.
  • Lead the Discovery and Insight vertical and its resourcing strategically, matching capacity to where the real work sits and bringing in the right technical expertise when needed
  • Develop people who can source, diligence, and hold partner relationships credibly in their own right â building a team of strong practitioners so Audacious's discovery capacity grows beyond any single person
  • Effectively steward relationships and actively collaborate with key Audacious partners (e.g., The Bridgespan Group) with whom we partner year-round

Qualifications

Career and Functional Experience

Essential

  • A leader who has set strategy in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments, and who can hold their own in rooms both with ultra-high net worth individuals and issue experts and with their own team, making consequential decisions grounded in clear principles and with conviction
  • Strong generalist fluency across geographic, social-change and innovation domains with the maturity and credibility to engage experts across them
  • Experience building and developing teams, leading change management efforts, and operating through influence across a senior leadership group
  • Access to, and standing within, networks across the social-change and social-innovation ecosystem

Strongly Preferred

  • Familiarity with multiple models across the sector â funder-collaborative platforms and other philanthropic sourcing and investment mechanisms
  • Experience in multinational and culturally diverse organizations

Personal Characteristics / Culture Fit

  • Strong mission orientation, high integrity leadership, alignment with Audaciousâ values
  • Creative, team-oriented, and collaborative, willing to pitch in where needed
  • Intellectually curious; a quick study who stays current on social change and emerging trends in philanthropy, and can lead on ways to evolve our work
  • Confident without certainty; decisive without rigidity
  • Judgment to lead through influence rather than ownership

What Success Looks Like

  • A strategy that evolves as the world does â growing sharper and more grounded cycle over cycle â because someone owns its development and can hold key decisions steady even when stakeholder interests pull in different directions
  • A clear, evolving sense of what belongs in Audacious's portfolio â built from what selection and diligence have taught, not assumed upfront
  • A network of donors and partners who stay engaged and where relationships are nurtured from inception, and where trust, learning, and respect are built over time
  • Recommendations reaching the Executive Director hold up because the diligence, learning, and collaboration behind them are real and rigorous

Additional Information

The deadline to submit an application for the Managing Director, Discovery & Insight role is August 19, 2026, at 11:59 pm EST.

TED Conferences LLC is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We invite all qualified candidates to apply online with their cover letter and resume.

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Help grow an independent magazine dedicated to investigative journalism, culture and ideas.


Clandestine Magazine is looking for a Social Media Manager on a part-time voluntary basis to help grow our social media presence and introduce our work to new audiences.


We are an independent volunteer-led publication covering the stories, ideas and cultural movements shaping our world. 


We are not a conventional magazine. Our editorial landscape spans 12 topics â

Affairs â World Affairs, Cities, Environment, Philosophy, Politics and the Progressive World.

Culture â Art, Fashion, Film, Literature, Music and Technology.


Alongside our core features, we publish investigative reporting, immersive gonzo journalism, long-form essays and showcase emerging artists.


As a volunteer-led publication, we're building something with purpose. Beyond journalism, we also support charitable initiatives including a community kitchen and projects supporting people experiencing homelessness.


The Role

You'll take ownership of our social media strategy and help build a distinctive, recognisable presence that reflects the quality of our journalism and creative work.

Responsibilities include:

  • Developing and executing an Instagram & Tiktok content strategy.
  • Creating engaging posts, carousels, stories and reels.
  • Planning and maintaining a content calendar.
  • Writing compelling captions aligned with our editorial voice.
  • Growing our audience organically through community engagement.
  • Identifying trends while maintaining our editorial identity.
  • Working with editors, writers and artists to showcase new features and projects.
  • Monitoring performance and suggesting ways to improve reach and engagement.


We're Looking For Someone Who

  • Has experience managing or growing an Instagram account (personal, professional or voluntary).
  • Has a strong eye for design, storytelling and visual presentation.
  • Understands what performs well on Instagram and Tiktok without relying on clickbait.
  • Is interested in journalism, culture, current affairs or the creative industries.
  • Is proactive, reliable and enjoys taking initiative.
  • Can commit a few hours each week.


What You'll Gain

  • A key leadership role within an ambitious independent publication.
  • Creative freedom to shape our social media strategy.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with writers, editors and artists from around the world.
  • Portfolio-building experience with published work and measurable growth.


About Clandestine


Explore the world â 12 topics.


Clandestine Magazine is an independent publication dedicated to investigative journalism, the cultural zeitgeist and the ideas shaping our time.


We believe in rigorous reporting, thoughtful storytelling and publishing work that is both intellectually engaging and thought-provoking. Our pages bring together investigative features, long-form essays and distinctive voices from around the world.


We are not a conventional magazine. Our editorial landscape spans 12 topics â


Affairs â World Affairs, Cities, Environment, Philosophy, Politics and the Progressive World.


Culture â Art, Fashion, Film, Literature, Music and Technology.


Alongside our core editorial, we publish 'Injustices', examining global issues, overlooked stories and the realities that often escape the headlines. 'Gonzo' features immersive, first-hand reporting, offering deeply personal perspectives on people, places and experiences, while 'Essays' provides a home for considered long-form writing and original thought. Creativity is equally central to Clandestine, and through our 'Your Art Here' section, we offer emerging and established artists a place to showcase their work, celebrating originality and the creative voices that shape the creative disciplines of today.


Beyond publishing, we are committed to supporting charitable initiatives that help those facing hardship. Kindness, compassion and respect for others remain central to our ethos, shaping both our work and the community we continue to build. We work alongside registered charities and currently run two of our own initiatives â a community kitchen providing support for those in need, and a 'Tap for the Homeless' scheme, offering a simple way to provide essential assistance to people experiencing homelessness.


More than a magazine, Clandestine is a collective of curious minds, writers, artists and readers brought together by a shared appreciation for thoughtful journalism and culture.

title: Program Delivery Officer Level 1
description:
In this role you will ensure a high level of community safety through the delivery of approved general and /or sexual offending programs to those offenders assessed as requiring offender intervention programs.

Mandatory Requirements

The following mandatory requirements apply to this role:

  • The possession of a tertiary qualification in preferably in psychology, social work, education or behavioural sciences, however, other Bachelor degrees may be considered at the discretion of the recruitment panel in consultation with Offender Rehabilitation and Management Services.
  • Membership or affiliation with a relevant professional association will be highly regarded
  • PDO specialising in the delivery of sexual offending programs you will be provided with training in the use of relevant assessment tools (STATIC-99 and STABLE-2000) to allocate sex offenders to appropriate treatment.

The primary accountabilities of the Program Delivery Officer (Level 1) include:

  • Participate in planning activities to ensure offenders have timely access to appropriate programs and interventions
  • Prepare offenders for offender intervention programs
  • Ensure offender program activities are consistent with evidence-based practice
  • Deliver offender intervention programs in accordance with operational plans
  • Provide advice to relevant officers regarding offender program suitability and/or other interventions
  • Monitor progress of offenders during programs and related activities and report on progress
  • Comply with program management procedures, standards and guidelines
  • Identify and respond appropriately to risks arising from offender management
  • Maintain own level of knowledge of contemporary offender programs research and practices, and legislation, policy and procedures in relation to offender management
  • Participate in case management activities as required for offenders assessed as requiring program participation
  • Provide timely information to relevant sites in relation to each offender's participation in programs for case management
  • Monitor offender management files and programs to ensure continuity and consistency
  • Ensure records and information data for the Integrated Offender Management system (IOMS) are accurate and current
  • Administer appropriate assessments to offenders
  • Analyse assessment results and record information
  • Contribute to case management and sentence management activities for offenders
  • Ensure records and information data for the Integrated Offender Management system (IOMS) and the Offender Programs Assessment Service (OPAS) are accurate and current
  • Ensure maintenance, accuracy and appropriateness of records and intervention reports, program data for appropriate authorities
  • Ensure the timely provision of advice to courts, boards and other agencies regarding offenders
  • Provide program impact reports to courts and parole boards for participants
  • Promote value of offender programs to relevant agencies and support services
  • Develop productive relationships with service providers and the community generally to enhance the community's regard for offender programs

The role description provides the minimum requirements for the role. The incumbent may be required to undertake other duties as required outside of these primary accountabilities.

Applications to remain current for 12 months.

Occupational group Psychology, Counselling & Social Work

title: Compatibility
description:
CompatibilityWorking at Stripe is not for everyone

Not everyone finds success at Stripe. Those who do tend to share a few things in common.

The right people donât always think theyâre right

Successful Stripes are rigorous thinkers who appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. We want people who are not afraid to be wrong, who can enthusiastically back proposals they initially opposed, and who know how to support decisions with numbers and narrative. We operate in situations of substantial uncertainty and cannot afford either timidity or recklessness.

The global financial system can seem like a mystifying domain. It isnât. Itâs made of people and computers, like many other systems youâve worked on. Most Stripes donât come from finance, and theyâve thrived by bringing fresh perspectives. We want generalists who can parachute anywhere into our operations, learn a new field quickly, and execute competently beyond their formal remit.

We know that we canât be successful without nurturing the careers of both generalists and experts. People who thrive in high-conflict work environments often do not enjoy the experience here. We try to embrace kindness while still encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Who is Stripe for?

Ambitious builders

Weâre building solutions without clear precedent, solving problems with far-reaching consequences. The people here find that energizing, preferring the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

Adaptable problem solvers

AI is changing how the global economy works, how our customers work, and how Stripes work. The people who thrive here adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities.

Rigorous thinkers

We argue from first principles, question assumptions, and donât stop at good enough. At Stripe, craft isnât a nice-to-haveâitâs the standard.

The most successful Stripes are the people who have the intellectual horsepower, the curiosity to learn a very complicated business, and the humility to get up every day and realize thereâs a huge amount of things they donât know.

Conor McNamaraHead of EMEA

What all Stripes have in common

Weâre dedicated to our work and optimistic about the world. We believe entrepreneurship and free markets do good, and building what supports them matters. If thatâs you, read on.

Motivated by our mission

Stripe is on a mission to grow the GDP of the internet.

Ask Yourself:

  • Do I see free markets and entrepreneurship as powerful forces for advancing progress?
  • Does enabling entrepreneurship and helping to unlock the internet economyâs full potential seem like a compelling use of my time and talents?

Embody our operating principles

âUsers firstâ is a cornerstone principle. Our users trust us to provide an essential service, and itâs a heavy responsibility that we take very seriously.

Ask Yourself:

  • Am I motivated to move mountains to protect and support businesses that depend on Stripe?
  • Am I driven to overcome obstacles and take on big things to drive progress, or do I feel overwhelmed by the sheer scale and breadth of sometimes nebulous opportunities?

Energized by change

The pace of change at Stripe and in the broader economy is accelerating. Youâll work outside your domain, take on problems that didnât exist a year ago, and be expected to adapt as quickly as the world does.

Ask Yourself:

  • Do I see a fast-moving environment as an opportunity rather than an obstacle?
  • Am I comfortable taking on problems outside my domain or experience?

Collaborative, multidisciplinary work

Building programmable financial infrastructure from first principles is inherently complex. It means that everything we create requires deep, collaborative, multidisciplinary work: technically, organizationally, and geographically.

Ask Yourself:

  • Am I excited by navigating complexity at scale?

How we operate

Youâll bring high standards to everything you do and find others who do the same.

Users first

We serve millions of businesses and a meaningful fraction of global GDP. We have a weighty responsibility to those businesses and to society. We work backwards from our usersâ needs, indexing especially on feedback from the most innovative. Everyone at Stripe talks to users.

Create with craft and beauty

With careful thought, anything can be made surprisingly great. Across every part of Stripe, we are committed to doing so. Well-crafted work indicates care for the user, and beautiful work indicates care for the world.

Move with urgency and focus

We move with speed on what matters most and take the time to invest in what will make us faster tomorrow. Whereas many companies get slower until theyâre eventually mired in mediocrity, we aspire to become the worldâs fastest company.

Collaborate egolessly

We work as one team: no fiefdoms, no hoarding information, no ânot my problem.â We question assumptions, debate energetically, and abandon ideas when better ones emerge. Weâre generous with credit and stingy with blame. We learn from mistakes together.

Stay curious

Stripe is an applied exercise in learning about how businesses tick and how the world works. Since the details and possibilities are infinite, we are always seeking to learn. Weâre energized by the unfamiliar, preferring the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

Obsess over talent

Itâs every Stripeâs responsibility to help hire the best and to push for excellence everywhere. Managers must relentlessly uphold our high talent bar, lead their teams with clarity and context, foster development, and ultimately support Stripes in accomplishing the best work of their careers.

Our culture

Like all great workplaces, Stripe has its own working culture, with norms that can surprise, delight, and occasionally perplex.

Friday Fireside

Friday Fireside is a weekly Stripe-wide forum hosted by Patrick and John. We hear from a Stripe user and get their unvarnished feedback, invite Stripes to chat about (or demo!) their recent work, and welcome external experts to discuss timely and relevant topics.

Convergence

Every December, Stripes come together for Convergenceâa full-day event and Stripe tradition dating back to 2014. Itâs a chance to reflect on the past year, hear about our priorities for the next year, learn from each other, and poke fun at ourselves.

How we show up in the world

  • Cheeky Pint

Ideas meet the pub hang. In this podcast series, John Collison sits down with founders, builders, and leaders to discuss their craft over a pint.

Watch Cheeky Pint

  • Stripe Press

Stripe Press publishes books about ideas for economic, technological, and scientific progress. We print works we think can be broadly useful.

Find Stripe Press titles

  • Works in Progress

Stripeâs online and print magazine focuses on scientific, technological and economic advancement.

Read about Works in Progress

  • Frontier

Launched in 2022, Frontier is Stripeâs advance market commitment to buy an initial $1.8B of permanent carbon removal by 2040.

Learn about Frontier

  • Intercept

A new initiative focused on dramatically reducing the burden of respiratory viruses.

Learn about Intercept

Frequently asked questions

What is it actually like to work at Stripe day to day?

Fast-paced, intellectually demanding, and creative. The volume is high, and the problems are high stakes. But you wonât be doing it aloneâwe work with egoless collaboration. Most Stripes will tell you the caliber of their teammates is one of the things they value most, and that it raises their own standard of work.

How does Stripe invest in your growth?

Through the work itself, mostly. Stripe gives people stretch projects early, which means youâre solving problems that are hard and consequential to the business. Beyond that, we offer mentorship, direct feedback, and an annual education stipend for courses, conferences, and resources that move your career forward. The expectation is that youâll grow quickly here. Weâre set up to support you.

How does AI shape the work here?

AI is embedded in how everyone at Stripe builds, analyzes, and operates. Engineers use AI tools daily to accelerate development. Teams across product, design, and operations are building AI-powered features for the businesses and consumers who rely on Stripe. We think carefully about where AI creates real value versus where it introduces risk.

What does it mean to do your best work here?

Stripe is a place to do career-defining work. The stakes are high: millions of businesses rely on Stripe. Itâs a responsibility that requires combining urgency with high standards, an often demanding mix. In exchange, you'll have the support and opportunity to pursue big ideas and change how things work, with a high degree of autonomy.

More on careers at Stripe

  • Get our perspective on why what we build matters.

Opportunity

  • Start your career at the center of the global economyâsee what we offer for early career opportunities.

Emerging talent

  • Weâre hiring. Explore our open roles and submit your application.

Open roles

title: Menu
description:
As Abraham Lincoln once said, âThe best way to predict the future is to create it.â If you want to advance your career but donât know where to start, here are some things you can do to get promoted at work.

By Michele Reynolds

  • Be a Model Employee

Rule number one for being a good employee is to always be on time and ready to go. Even if you work in a culture that runs behind schedule, itâs better to be on timeâor even earlyâeach day and to every meeting.

If youâre leading the meeting, show up with an agenda and be an active timekeeper. Itâs a sign that youâre organized, respect peopleâs time, and serve as a role model to peers. At the end of the meeting, give a quick recap and identify next steps.

  • Solve Problems, Donât Just Identify Them

One of the best ways to stand out as a budding leaderâregardless of your current roleâis to be self-sufficient and demonstrate solid judgment. Doing so wonât just set you apart as a critical asset to your team but also serve as a tactic to further develop your leadership skills. A helpful mantra is, âBe a problem solver, not a problem identifier.â

When you raise an issue to your boss, also propose a solution. Busy leaders often get bogged down by solving every problem their team faces. Do your boss a favor and find workarounds rather than just surface issues.

  • Respect Your Bossâs Time

Be considerate of your bossâs time. Before asking for help, consider the level of urgency and try solving the problemâor at least brainstorm a plan of action to run by your manager. Making an attempt first will demonstrate you know how to take initiative.

For things that require your bossâs intervention but arenât time-sensitive, keep a running list of items to discuss. Ask if you can get some time on your managerâs calendar and outline what youâd like to discuss in your meeting invite so you both come prepared.

  • Donât Be a Squeaky Wheel

Perhaps most important is a can-do attitude. Anything you can do to minimize your bossâs workload will likely benefit you in the long run. You can help by volunteering to take on something new or brainstorm solutions when a crisis pops up.

Baseball great Wade Boggs once said, âA positive attitude causes a chain reaction of positive thoughts, events, and outcomes. Itâs a catalyst, and it sparks extraordinary results.â

So, whatever you do, donât be a whiner. Even if youâre feeling stressed, save your venting for a friend and present a positive front to your boss.

  • Serve as a Vault

Earn trust by keeping information about confidential or sensitive subjects to yourself. Beyond that, donât gossip or backstab at the water cooler. By being a stand-up employee, youâll earn trust and respect.

  • Make Your Boss Look Good

Staying organized and moving quickly can make you, and your boss, look good. But donât move too fast. Getting things done efficiently is important, but quality matters, too.

Ensure your work represents your company well. If you take on additional responsibilities, confirm they align with whatâs expected of you. Your work reflects on your boss, so make sure theyâre proud of you and your product.

  • Ask for Advice

It may seem counterintuitive, but asking your boss for advice can yield dividends. According to research (pdf) by Harvard Business School Professor Alison Wood-Brooks, âIndividuals perceive those who seek advice as more competent than those who do not.â

Timed right, asking your boss for guidance can work to your advantage.

  • Speak Up

As Aristotle said, âThereâs only one way to avoid criticism: Do nothing, say nothing, and be nothing.â Since youâre reading this article, you clearly want to stand out, so speak up.

Confidently sharing your views and expertise in conversations or meetings allows you to demonstrate your knowledge and skills. You can also make an impression on your colleagues and superiors.

  • Project Confidence

Being a strong communicator is more than what you say. How you say itâboth in your body language and tone of voiceâmay matter more than the words themselves.

Albert Mehrabian, a professor at the University of California, Los Angeles, and an expert in nonverbal communication, proved through his research that what you say is negligible compared to how you say it. Body language and inflection matter more.

âNonverbal elements are particularly important for communicating feelings and attitude, especially when theyâre incongruent: If words and body language disagree, one tends to believe the body language,â Mehrabian told the site Right Attitudes.

That said, you can look like a leader through confident body language, such as your posture, stance, handshake, eye contact, and smile.

  • Advance Your Education

What else can you do to propel your career growth? If you want to sharpen your skills but donât have the time or resources to go back to school full- or even part-time, consider taking an online course.

According to HBS Professor Das Narayandas, thereâs a plethora of options that can benefit you and your employer.

As Narayandas said to the Harvard Business Review, âThe good news is that the growing assortment of online courses, social and interactive platforms, and learning tools from both traditional institutions and upstartsâ¦offers a solution. [Theyâre] flexible and immediately accessible, and it enables employees to pick up skills in the context in which they must be used. In effect, itâs a 21st-century form of on-the-job training.â

There are many affordable online business courses that can work around your schedule. Your employer might even cover the cost.

One to consider is Leadership Principles. It features interactive exercises to help you if youâre an early- or mid-career professional preparing for a leadership role.

description:
FIFO Fire Technician â Groote Eylandt (1 Week On / 1 Week Off)

Chubb Fire & Security â Darwin Based FIFO Opportunity

Are you a skilled Fire Technician looking for an exciting FIFO role with incredible lifestyle balance? This is an opportunity to join Chubb Fire & Security, working one week on / one week off to support our major client on Groote Eylandt - GEMCO Sth32, while enjoying stability, training, and progression with a national market leader.

The Role

Based out of our Darwin Fire Division, you will fly from Darwin to Groote Eylandt on a 7/7 FIFO roster. You will be responsible for servicing, maintaining, and supporting fire protection assets across the site, ensuring high reliability, compliance, and exceptional customer service.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

  • Servicing, testing and maintaining fire protection assets to Chubb standards of safety, quality and delivery.
  • Completing scheduled maintenance, defect remediation and upgrade works.
  • Providing excellent customer service and technical support to our client on site.
  • Completing all documentation via the GEMCO Sth32 internal reporting system
  • Working closely with Darwin Fire Management to ensure seamless reporting, parts management and workflow planning.

Systems You Will Work On (highlighted For Editing)

ð¥ Fire Detection & Alarm Systems (e.g., Ampac)

ð¥ Sprinkler & Deluge Systems

ð¥ Gaseous Suppression Systems (e.g., Inergen / FM200)

ð¥ Fire Pump Sets

ð¥ VESDA / Aspiration Systems

To Be Successful

While experience in the Fire industry is highly regarded, it isnât essential. If you are motivated, service-driven and eager to grow your career, we will support you through full training.

You Will Need

  • Previous fire industry experience (preferred but not essential).
  • A Certificate II, Cert III or FPAS in Fire Protection (or willingness to obtain).
  • Current driverâs licence
  • White Card.
  • Ability to work FIFO on a 7/7 roster.
  • Able to pass a Police Check and Medical
  • Strong communication skills and customer-focused attitude.
  • Good time management and independence while working remotely.
  • Self-motivated, reliable and committed to safety at all times.

Benefits

Joining Chubb means joining a global fire & security leader with unmatched support and development.

  • Highly competitive wages + site allowance.
  • FIFO from Darwin with flights, accommodation and meals provided.
  • All tools, equipment and PPE supplied.
  • National and global career progression opportunities.
  • Strong training pathways and qualification assistance.
  • Supportive, high-performing team culture.
  • Excellent job stability and long-term career outlook.

Diversity & Inclusion

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experience levels.

How to Apply

If this sounds like the perfect next step in your career, please apply via the link.

For Questions Prior To Applying, Contact

gareth.masterson@chubbfs.com

thomas.young@chubbfs.com

Additional Information

About Us, Our Culture & What We Can Offer You

Established over 200 years ago, Chubb Fire & Security are a global business driven by keeping people and the world safe. We provide essential systems, equipment and services, from digital CCTV surveillance and intruder alarms, to fire detection and suppression systems. Offering a full range of innovative products and services to a broad range of customers, from local independent business, to many of the FTSE 100 companies

We believe we offer a unique working culture, where you are as important to us as our customers, and we want you to feel that everyday. We are proud to offer extensive training to all of our new Advisors, fully supporting, and enabling you to thrive in your new role and beyond, with ongoing career development opportunities throughout your career journey with us.

title: Calling Specialist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 


Thank you for showing interest in Outreach Specialist role at KSNL Consulting LLC! Before we move forward, we want to make sure you have a full picture of what we do and what this job actually looks like day to day.

Who we are: KSNL Consulting is a project consulting firm. Every day, thousands of commercial projects hits the portal we work from â Nature of the projects can be any project from changing a bulb to providing aircraft maintenance project. Our company stick to the practical, everyday services: commercial cleaning, landscaping, transportation, roof replacement, electrical, plumbing, and others like it. Our job is to match those projects with the right vendors and manage everything in between.

Your job: You'd be the person making that match happen. Here's how it works â we hand you a project summary with the location, frequency, required certificates, insurance, and materials. You take that summary, put it in your own words, and explain it to vendors over calls and texts. And here's the best part: you're not selling them anything. You're offering them business for work they already do.

On every first call, you'll need to do three things: explain the project, collect the vendor's cell number and business email, and lock in their site visit appointment. That contact info matters â all our follow-ups happen over text, and you'll follow up with each vendor at least 4 times.

The numbers: This is a high-volume outbound call role. You'll be making 150â200 calls a day, plus reaching out to project managers and contracting officers.

If that sounds like something you'd thrive in and  you have the proficient in English Communication, then follow the STEPS.

STEP#1:  Please send us a at least ONE MINUTE VOICE NOTE  explaining your academic and professional accomplishments. Also do tell us about your journey. Also give us a good reason why you think you are the best candidate for this position. WhatsApp number +17032204299

STEP#2: Complete the Application Form and Trial Task given in this form (follow the instructions). and mail at ksnl.federal@gmail.com

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1f32l5IiqhfqALYLH6gHwVBPHsDEdxyEZ67K-099xcW0/preview

STEP#3: Setup an interview call on CALENDLY by clicking this link .             https://calendly.com/humanresource-ksnl/30min


FEW THINGS TO KEEP IN MIND

1. You will be connected on zoom, sharing your screen for the time allocated to work.

2. Your mic shall be UNMUTED at all times during 10 Hour working hours. 60 min of Break

3. NO BACKGROUND NOISE due to the fact THAT YOU WILL BE WORKING IN A GROUP SETTING AND CALLING VENDORS

4. This is a FULL TIME POSITION. No other job will be allowed.



Qualifications

Excellent English verbal and written communication skills

Experience in outboarding calling to North American and European Clients.

Experience in detailing high call volume approximately 150 - 200.

Able to understand complex project and explain in simple words.

Able to talk convincingly with the vendors and able to persuade the vendor for site survey.

title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

We train and manage healthcare graduates to conduct remote, telephonic patient interactions using our purpose-built software. The result: patients receive timely support, healthcare organizations extend their capacity, and you gain real clinical experience.</span></p><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-9ce6a45c-7fff-b3a4-432d-8169b305997a">THE ROLE</strong></span></h5><p><span>As a GFH Patient Outreach Specialist, you'll conduct structured phone-based interactions with patients on behalf of our partner healthcare organizations. title: Analytics Engineer (w/m/d)
description:
Daten sind für uns kein Nebenprodukt, sondern ein zentraler Erfolgsfaktor und das Fundament unserer KI-Strategie. Als Analytics Engineer (m/w/d) bist du die treibende Kraft hinter unserer Datenplattform: Du baust und pflegst die Datenmodelle, auf denen Analytics, Reporting und Data Science im gesamten Unternehmen aufsetzen. Mit robusten, skalierbaren und vertrauenswürdigen Pipelines sorgst du dafür, dass alle Teams auf einer sauberen, konsistenten Datenbasis arbeiten – und machst unser Unternehmen damit messbar datengetriebener und KI-fähiger.

Schwerpunkte deiner Rolle

  • Du entwickelst und pflegst dbt-Modelle und Datenpipelines, die Rohdaten in saubere, dokumentierte und verlässliche Datensätze überführen

  • Du etablierst eine Single Source of Truth für Kennzahlen und sorgst dafür, dass alle Teams mit denselben vertrauenswürdigen Zahlen arbeiten

  • Du designst skalierbare Data-Warehouse-Schemata (dimensionales Modell, Fakten/Dimensionen) mit Fokus auf Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Kosten

  • Du integrierst Daten aus unternehmensweiten Systemen in unseren Data Lake / unser Data Warehouse und führst systemübergreifende Datenflüsse zusammen

  • Du baust und pflegst Dashboards und Reports (z. B. in Metabase), die Fachbereiche zu eigenständigem, datenbasiertem Handeln befähigen

  • Du sicherst und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Datenqualität – inkl. Monitoring, dbt-Tests und klarer Standards für zuverlässige Analytics- und KI-Use-Cases

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Operations, Produkt, Engineering und dem Leadership-Team zusammen und übersetzt Business-Fragen in aussagekräftige Metriken und Analysen

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Scientist oder in einer vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Rolle

  • Sehr gute SQL-Skills sowie praktische Erfahrung mit dbt in Produktionsumgebungen (inkl. Tests, Dokumentation, CI/CD und GitHub-Workflows)

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Datenmodellierung, Data-Warehouse-Design, ETL-/ELT-Prozessen und der Auswirkungen auf Skalierbarkeit und Reporting-Performance

  • Praxiserfahrung mit Snowflake (oder vergleichbaren Cloud-DWH-/Data-Lake-Lösungen) sowie einem BI-Tool wie Metabase, Power BI oder Tableau

  • Kenntnisse in Python oder einem ähnlichen Skript-/Analyse-Tool zur tiefergehenden Analyse, Prototyping und Automatisierung

  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten und Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären – hohe Service- und Lösungsorientierung im Umgang mit internen Stakeholdern

  • Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Ownership-Mentalität und sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Das bieten wir Dir

 

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten
Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung
Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

title: Strategic Enterprise Account Executive (m/w/d) - Germany
description:
About Multiverse StackFuel

Multiverse x StackFuel is the leading provider of data and AI upskilling programmes in Germany.

In 2025, StackFuel was acquired by Multiverse and we are now building our GTM engine for the enterprise market, to replicate the UK trajectory in Germany. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you get the best of both worlds: StackFuel’s local expertise and product-market fit combined with Multiverse’s GTM leadership, sales playbooks and resources.

Together with our customers, we are redefining how people learn and work, enabling organisations to successfully navigate AI adoption.

Our mission is to open up new career paths for people around the world through practical, future-proof training in data and AI, while helping organisations build the capabilities they need for the digital age.

In this role as an Enterprise Account Executive, you will play a direct and visible part in advancing this mission with our enterprise customers in Germany.

 
 

The role

As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, you are uniquely positioned to accelerate AI adoption and enablement by delivering a value proposition that sits at the core of German enterprises’ transformation strategies:

  • Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts in Germany.

  • Be responsible for winning new customers and growing existing ones.

  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing.

You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Marketing and Product to bring the best of Multiverse StackFuel to our customers and drive measurable business outcomes for them.

 
 

What you’ll do

  • Ramp up quickly on the Multiverse GTM playbook, supported by market‑leading sales training and a strong development culture.

  • Apply and master the MEDDICC methodology to qualify, manage and scale your pipeline and opportunities.

  • Own new business activities in our most strategic enterprise accounts – including building and nurturing relationships with decision-makers at C‑level and C‑2.

  • Deeply understand your prospects’ challenges around digital transformation, capacity, capabilities and diversity – and position Multiverse StackFuel solutions in a way that clearly links to their strategic priorities and business outcomes.

  • Systematically build champions to win new logos, convert upsell and cross-sell opportunities, and develop accounts into strategic key accounts.

  • Build, grow and manage your own portfolio of strategic existing customers with a long-term, value-based approach.

 
 

What you’ll bring

  • You have 6+ years of closing experience in an enterprise B2B sales environment

  • You have a proven track record in creating and driving new business and are always looking for ways to grow business with your clients through strategic approaches

  • You can build and deliver a thorough end-to-end sales process

  • Experience working with MEDDICC or a similar qualification framework.

  • Proven top performance in previous roles, with strong target orientation and a clear drive to win.

  • You are high energy and driven to continually raise the bar in terms of performance and expectations

  • Fluent German and very good English skills, both written and spoken.

  • Strong interest in technological developments in AI and in how these can be translated into effective learning experiences.

 
 

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package with base salary and performance-based commission.

  • Hybrid working culture with modern offices in Berlin, Munich and Düsseldorf.

  • A mission-driven environment at the intersection of education, data and AI.

  • Dedicated budget and time for learning and professional development.

  • Collaborative, supportive team culture with regular feedback and coaching.

 

How we hire

  1. Intro call with Talent

  2. Interview with Hiring Manager, Regional Director

  3. Interview with our VP for Germany, Frank Wenzel

  4. Final Challenge Interview (Panel)

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities and experiences.

Multiverse x StackFuel is the leading provider of data and AI upskilling programmes in Germany.

In 2025, StackFuel was acquired by Multiverse and we are now building our GTM engine for the enterprise and mid market, to replicate the UK trajectory in Germany. As a Mid Market Account Executive, you get the best of both worlds: StackFuel’s local expertise and product-market fit combined with Multiverse’s GTM leadership, sales playbooks and resources.

Together with our customers, we are redefining how people learn and work, enabling organisations to successfully navigate AI adoption.

Our mission is to open up new career paths for people around the world through practical, future-proof training in data and AI, while helping organisations build the capabilities they need for the digital age.

In this role as an Mid Market Account Executive, you will play a direct and visible part in advancing this mission with our mid market customers in Germany.

 
 

The role

As an Mid Market Account Executive, you are uniquely positioned to accelerate AI adoption and enablement by delivering a value proposition that sits at the core of German mid market’ transformation strategies:

  • Own a portfolio of strategic mid market accounts in Germany.

  • Be responsible for winning new customers and growing existing ones.

  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing.

You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Marketing and Product to bring the best of Multiverse StackFuel to our customers and drive measurable business outcomes for them.

 
 

What you’ll do

  • Ramp up quickly on the Multiverse GTM playbook, supported by market‑leading sales training and a strong development culture.

  • Apply and master the MEDDICC methodology to qualify, manage and scale your pipeline and opportunities.

  • Systematically build champions to win new logos, convert upsell and cross-sell opportunities, and develop accounts into strategic key accounts.

  • Build, grow and manage your own portfolio of strategic existing customers with a long-term, value-based approach.

 
 

What you’ll bring

  • You have 3+ years of closing experience in an mid market B2B sales environment

  • You have a proven track record in creating and driving new business and are always looking for ways to grow business with your clients through strategic approaches

  • You can build and deliver a thorough end-to-end sales process

  • Proven top performance in previous roles, with strong target orientation and a clear drive to win.

  • You are high energy and driven to continually raise the bar in terms of performance and expectations

  • Fluent German and very good English skills, both written and spoken.

  • Experience working with MEDDICC or a similar qualification framework.

  • Competitive compensation package with base salary and performance-based commission.

  • Hybrid working culture with modern offices in Berlin, Munich and Düsseldorf.

  1. Intro call with Talent

This role is required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the design direction and the UX/UI pattern system across the apps surface. Navigation, mental models, and UI consistency cut across Apps Meta, Retention, and Design Systems at once, and you hold that cross-cutting direction so three teams ship one coherent experience rather than three versions of it.

  • Lead native craft across iOS and Android. Set the approach for resizability, foldables, new screen sizes, and solve how KAYAK responds to platform chrome shifts like Liquid Glass and Material 3 Expressive.

  • Raise the ceiling for the other apps designers through critique, shared standards, and patterns they build on. Designers should get better by working alongside you and using what you establish, not only through direct mentorship.

Required Skills

  • 10+ years in product design, with a portfolio of shipped, high-impact mobile work at consumer scale.

  • Deep native expertise across iOS and Android. Mastery of Apple HIG and Material Design, and the judgment to know when to converge and when to honor platform difference. Hands-on experience with resizability, foldables, and iPad, and a point of view on platform chrome directions like Liquid Glass and Material 3 Expressive.

  • A track record of raising design quality across a discipline beyond your own projects, through standards you set, critiques you ran, or systems others still use.

Was du mitbringst

  • Gute Kenntnisse von IT-Infrastrukturen, Sicherheitskomponenten und Netzwerkprotokollen (z. B. Firewalls, Switches, Router, PKI, ICMP, HTTP, ARP, SSH und IPv4/IPv6)

Was wir dir bieten

Womit wir dir einen echten Mehrwert bieten:

Was für uns selbstverständlich ist und Ausdruck unserer WIR-Kultur:
  • Mobiles und flexibles Arbeiten sorgt für deine optimale Work-Life Integration

 *Die abgebildeten Leistungen können je nach Unternehmen, Standort und Land leicht variieren.


Über uns

Seit mehr als 20 Jahren ist die IPG Pionier und Experte im Bereich Identity & Access Management und Governance. Namhafte Kunden aller Branchen wie auch Organisationen der öffentlichen Verwaltung in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Österreich vertrauen auf den Service und die Expertise von IPG für einen umfassenden Schutz von Benutzerdaten sowie Zugriffs- und Zutrittsrechten.
 
IPG ist Teil der TIMETOACT GROUP - einem der führenden IT Dienstleister für Cloud-Plattformen und digitale Lösungen. Mit mehr als 1.700 Kolleginnen und Kollegen arbeiten wir in 25 Städten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie in Niederlassungen in Italien, den Niederlanden, Spanien und den USA. Ergänzt wird unser Netzwerk durch Service Hubs in Mittelamerika, Mittel- und Osteuropa sowie Südostasien.
 
Für dich bedeutet das u.a.: vielfältige Karrierewege, Zugang zu Academy-Angeboten und unserer GROUP-weiten Initiative für Frauen, attraktive Benefits und Events – und das gute Gefühl, in einem starken Netzwerk zu arbeiten, das Zusammenhalt großschreibt. Feel the WE in IT.

Bei 1KOMMA5° bauen wir Europas führende Energie-Software-Plattform “Heartbeat” und schaffen so ein virtuelles Kraftwerk, das Photovoltaik, Stromspeicher, Wärmepumpen und Ladesäulen der Kunden verknüpft und so die Rentabilität vernetzter Kundenanlagen deutlich erhöht. Wir bieten Kunden zudem einen "One-Stop-Shop" für den Kauf und die Installation individueller und intelligenter Energie-Systemlösungen, damit jeder Haushalt schnell und professionell klimaneutral wohnen, heizen und mobil sein kann. Gleichzeitig arbeiten wir in unserer Technologie-Sparte an der Weiterentwicklung und dem Ausbau der Heartbeat-Software, um Kunden weltweit mit dem Strommarkt zu vernetzen und so immer den günstigsten und saubersten Stromtarif anbieten zu können.

Hast du Lust, die Energierevolution mit uns anzugehen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer Mission!


Deine Position

  • Du begleitest die Geschäftsführung im Tagesgeschäft und unterstützt verlässlich bei allen operativen sowie strategischen Fragestellungen.

  • Du übernimmst das Management unserer gesamten Fahrzeugflotte und koordinierst zuverlässig alle Leasingverträge, Werkstatttermine sowie die komplette Schadenabwicklung.
  • Im Rahmen unseres Kostencontrollings übernimmst du eigenständig Nachkalkulationen, identifizierst Potenziale für Kosteneinsparungen und setzt diese zielgerichtet um.
  • Bestehende Prozesse und interne Abläufe hinterfragst du proaktiv und baust effiziente, skalierbare Strukturen auf, um unser Wachstum optimal zu unterstützen.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in BWL oder Wirtschaftsrecht, oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Ausbildung und bringst im besten Fall bereits erste Erfahrungen in einem oder mehreren der benannten Tätigkeitsbereiche mit
  • Dank deines ausgeprägten Zahlen- und Organisationsverständnisses arbeitest du extrem strukturiert, detailorientiert und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Projekten und Fristen immer den Überblick.
  • Mit deiner lösungsorientierten „Hands-on“-Mentalität wartest du nicht auf Aufgaben, sondern packst proaktiv an, denkst unternehmerisch und gehst absolut diskret sowie flexibel mit wechselnden Herausforderungen um.

Du erfüllst nicht jedes einzelne Kriterium zu 100 %?
Kein Problem! Erzähl uns einfach, warum du trotzdem davon überzeugt bist, das perfekte Match für diese Position zu sein. Bei uns zählen deine Persönlichkeit und dein Drive genauso viel wie dein Lebenslauf.

title: (Senior) Software Engineer - Device Connectivity (Go) (m/f/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Deine Position

At 1KOMMA5°, we connect and manage tens of thousands of distributed energy devices at scale. As a (Senior) Software Engineer - Device Connectivity, you will play a crucial role in integrating OEM devices, such as PV inverters, batteries, charging infrastructure, and heat pumps, into our cutting-edge Heartbeat platform. Your role involves implementing communication protocols, developing software modules on IoT gateway and controller devices, and conducting testing of our energy management system in our lab in Berlin. You will also be providing expert level support for both internal and external stakeholders. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you'll contribute to the entire product lifecycle.

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own the technical integration of inverters, batteries, charging infrastructure, and heat pumps into our Heartbeat energy management system, driving projects end-to-end to deliver solutions on time.
  • Ensure seamless communication and interoperability between different OEM devices.
  • Implement communication protocols such as Modbus TCP, OCPP, MQTT, EEbus.
  • Develop, deploy, and maintain services on our IoT gateway using Go programming.
  • Diagnose network issues across LAN/WAN, VPN, firewalls, and protocols, and turn that understanding into resilient edge services.
  • Conduct testing of our energy management system in our lab in Berlin.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure software meets performance and reliability standards.
  • Provide expert-level support to both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Foster a culture of experiment-driven innovation within the team


Dein Profil

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Control Engineering or related field.
  • Proven experience in IoT development and integration, with a focus on integrating diverse OEM devices.
  • Hands-on experience in the development of software modules for IoT devices.
  • Experience with Go programming is highly preferred.
  • Proficiency in communication protocols such as Modbus TCP, OCPP, and MQTT.
  • Solid understanding of local area networks (TCP/IP, LAN/WLAN) and experience with device discovery and scanning mechanisms within home networks.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools, including continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • Prior exposure to energy management systems is desirable.
  • Outstanding, proactive communication skills: you excel at engaging stakeholders and initiating cross-team collaboration
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience quickly finding your way around in cross-functional teams in a fast pace, interdisciplinary working environment
  • An agile and result-oriented mindset and you consider yourself a team player
  • Very good knowledge of spoken and written English, German is a plus
Bonus points for:
  • Experience in network or systems administration (routing, firewalls, DNS, DHCP) in a production environment.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (ideally Google cloud) and their integration in IoT solutions.
  • Previous experience in providing support to international stakeholders.
  • Certifications related to IoT and energy management
We are an ambitious and dynamic company with a talented team. We require our engineers to be imaginative, enthusiastic, and willing to tackle new challenges as we strive to provide everyone with renewable energy technologies.


Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • You move in flat hierarchies and have short decision-making paths. You can learn a lot quickly and get involved at different levels
  • You will be welcomed by a friendly and familiar team
  • You are part of the energy transition and recognize in your daily work what purpose it serves
  • You can work in one of our offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • You create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Wir bauen die technologische Infrastruktur für CO₂-Prämien in der Elektromobilität: regulatorische Prozesse und Finanzflüsse für B2C- und B2B-Kunden, digital abgewickelt.

Das heißt konkret: Statusmodelle mit rechtlicher Konsequenz, Auszahlungslogik, Nachweisketten, Schnittstellen zu Behörden und Partnern. Die Domäne ist der schwierige Teil, nicht das Framework.

Die spannende Aufgabe der nächsten Monate: Unsere Hauptanwendung läuft auf Rails 8. Zwei weitere Anwendungen sollen in diese Codebasis aufgenommen werden. Das ist keine Portierungsarbeit, sondern eine Modellierungsfrage — drei gewachsene Domänen mit überlappenden Begriffen zu einem konsistenten System zusammenführen, ohne dass am Ende alles mit allem zusammenhängt. Wer gern über Bounded Contexts und die richtigen Schnitte nachdenkt, findet hier reichlich Substanz.

Wir betreiben auf Linode und Bare Metal mit PostgreSQL, Redis und Sidekiq. CI/CD läuft über GitHub Actions, Monitoring und Observability über AppSignal.

Das Team besteht aus vier Entwicklern und einem Product Owner, davon zwei Rails-Seniors. Wir haben eine gemeinsame Vorstellung davon, wo die Systemarchitektur hin soll, und beraten uns gegenseitig zu unseren Lösungen. Entscheidungen fallen im Team, nicht auf einer Ebene darüber.

Aufgaben

  • Konsolidierung - Du führst zwei bestehende Anwendungen in die Rails-8-Codebasis über und triffst dabei die Schnitte, die das System danach tragen.

  • Domänenmodell schärfen - Du überführst gewachsene Geschäftslogik in tragfähige Abstraktionen und benennst Prozesse so, wie das Business sie tatsächlich denkt — nicht so, wie die Tabelle gerade heißt.

  • Features end-to-end - Vom Spec-Gespräch mit dem Product Owner bis zum Deployment auf Production.

  • Architektur mitgestalten - Du bringst deine Sicht in die Architekturdiskussion ein, lässt dich von der Sicht der anderen überzeugen und hältst gemeinsam Getroffenes durch.

  • Wissen weitergeben - Pull Requests sind bei uns der Ort, an dem Rails-Wissen wandert in beide Richtungen. Du schreibst Reviews, aus denen jemand etwas lernt, und ziehst weniger erfahrene Entwickler aktiv hoch.

  • Deployment und Betrieb - Du machst den Deploy-Prozess schneller und verlässlicher.

  • Standards - Style Guides und Konventionen tragen und weiterentwickeln, damit der Code bei vier Entwicklern wie von einer Hand aussieht.

Qualifikation

Must have

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre produktive Rails-Erfahrung an einer Anwendung, die du über längere Zeit betreut hast — nicht nur aufgesetzt.
  • Affinität zu Domain Driven Design. Du erkennst, wann ein Modell zu viel weiß, wann eine Abstraktion fehlt und wann ein Begriff im Code nicht dem im Fachgespräch entspricht.
  • Mentoring-Mindset. Du erklärst gern, warum etwas so gelöst ist, und siehst Reviews nicht als Qualitätskontrolle, sondern als Wissenstransfer.
  • Keine Scheu vor einem puren Ubuntu-Server. SSH, systemd, Logs, Deployment-Scripte — du arbeitest direkt auf der Maschine, wenn es nötig ist.
  • Bereitschaft, dich an bestehende Style Guides zu halten und sie zu verbessern, statt sie zu umgehen.

title: Steuerfachangestellter / Steuerfachwirt / Bilanzbuchhalter / Trainee Steuerberatung (m/w/d)
description:
Partnerschaft auf Augenhöhe.
Wir stellen uns vor.

Seit nunmehr 20 Jahren stellen wir an unseren beiden Standorten in Bad Homburg und Darmstadt einen verlässlichen Partner dar – für unsere breitgefächerte Mandantschaft und allen voran für unser loyales, knapp 30-köpfiges Team. Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit mit unserem Kanzleierfolg einhergeht, und geben unser Bestes, dies auch beizubehalten. Denn ein gutes Betriebsklima zu gewährleisten, liegt vor allem in der Hand der Kanzleiführung. Herausforderungen im Kollektiv anzugehen ist nicht nur förderlich für das Wohlbefinden innerhalb unserer heiligen Hallen – es ist auch noch die perfekte Grundlage für eine vielversprechende Karriere, bei der wir Dich selbstverständlich unterstützen werden.

Aufgaben

So vielfältig wie das Steuerrecht.
Dein Aufgabengebiet.

Wie ein klassischer Tag bei SBC aussieht? Das hängt ganz von Dir ab! Denn Deinen individuellen Tätigkeitsbereich erstellen wir, natürlich in enger Abstimmung mit Dir, basierend auf Deinen Interessen, Talenten und Fähigkeiten. Und da jeder Mensch seine eigenen Stärken (und Schwächen) hat, gestaltet sich Dein Arbeitsalltag ganz nach Deinem Geschmack. Unter anderem erwarten Dich folgende Aufgaben:

  • Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung unserer Mandanten
  • Finanzbuchhaltung
  • Erstellen von Steuererklärungen und Jahresabschlüssen
  • Bearbeitung steuerlicher Fragestellungen
  • Vorbereitung und Begleitung von Betriebsprüfungen
  • Kommunikation mit Mandanten
  • Weitere Tätigkeiten, die Dir Spaß bereiten

Qualifikation

Wir bringen Dich weiter.
Und Du bringst ein paar Dinge mit.

Wir sind innerhalb der Branche für eine oft langjährige Zusammenarbeit bekannt – mit Mitarbeitern und Mandanten. Dies ist ein Indikator dafür, dass sich das Team und die Mandantschaft bei uns wohlfühlen und auch in beruflicher Hinsicht zufrieden mit unserer Kanzlei sind. Eine ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und eine verlässliche, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sind daher nicht verhandelbar. Zudem legst Du folgende Eigenschaften an den Tag:

  • Ausbildung zum Steuerfachangestellten, Steuerfachwirt oder Bilanzbuchhalter (alle m/w/d)
  • Gute Kenntnisse in MS-Office und DATEV
  • Im Optimalfall 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung
  • Digitalisierung ist für Dich der nötige Fortschritt
  • Veränderungen gegenüber bist Du aufgeschlossen

Benefits

Wer etwas will, muss auch etwas zu bieten haben.
Und das haben wir!

Obstkörbe und Gratis-Kaffee sind zwar schön, aber sicherlich nicht der entscheidende Faktor, wenn es um die Zufriedenheit des Teams geht. Um einen attraktiven Arbeitgeber darzustellen, bedarf es spürbarer Benefits und Annehmlichkeiten, die sowohl das Berufs- als auch das Privatleben positiv beeinflussen und Dir den Alltag erleichtern. Dazu gehört beispielsweise, dass der Zusammenhalt und ein angenehmes Miteinander über dem Umsatz stehen sollten – Mitarbeiter, die schlechte Stimmung verbreiten und ihre Ellbogen ausfahren, haben keinen Platz in unserer Mitte. Da gehen wir keine Kompromisse ein. Außerdem erwarten Dich:

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Modelle, inklusive Home-Office:
    Uns ist wichtig, dass die Qualität Deiner Arbeit stimmt – wann und wo Du diese erbringst, spielt eher eine sekundäre Rolle.
  • Work-Life-Balance:
    Arbeit ist wichtig, jedoch nicht das Wichtigste im Leben. Um Berufs- und Privatleben optimal unter einen Hut zu bekommen, bedarf es der Unterstützung Deines Arbeitgebers – auf uns kannst Du zählen.
  • Team-Events:
    Nur eine Weihnachtsfeier und das war’s wieder für ein Jahr? Nicht bei uns – regelmäßige ausgefallene Veranstaltungen wie Städtetrips, Krimi-Dinner, Ski-Ausflüge und andere gemeinsame Happy Hours wie Restaurantbesuche sorgen dafür, dass es auch neben dem Kanzleialltag nie langweilig wird.
  • Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote inkl. eigener Mentor:
    Man kann Fachkräfte einkaufen – oder auf die eigenen Talente setzen. Durch weitreichende Fortbildungsangebote helfen wir Dir, die Karriereleiter nach oben zu klettern. Ob nun durch unsere substanzielle und finanzielle Unterstützung - oder einem persönlichen Mentor, der Dir stets zur Seite steht.
  • Offene Kultur:
    In unserer Kanzlei wirst Du offene Türen, flache Hierarchien, kurze Kommunikations- und Entscheidungswege und eine wertschätzende Duz-Kultur vorfinden. Ein fachlicher Austausch mit den Berufsträgern ist nicht nur jederzeit möglich, sondern wird auch gern gesehen.
  • Weitere Annehmlichkeiten:
    Kanzleieigene Parkplätze, monatliche Sachbezüge in Höhe von 50 € und eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge gestalten Deinen Alltag angenehmer – beruflich und privat!
  • Was darf’s sonst noch sein?
    Wie schon bemerkt, sind alle Menschen verschieden. Wenn Dir etwas auf dem Herzen liegt, dass Du gerne in unserem Benefit-Portfolio aufnehmen willst, sag uns einfach Bescheid. Wir können über alles reden: E-Bike? Firmenhandy? Lass es uns wissen!

Der Ball liegt nun bei Dir.

Nein, das ist keine Dating-Plattform, fühlt sich aber fast so an. Wenn Dir gefällt, was Du liest, kannst Du Dich innerhalb weniger Minuten bei uns bewerben – vielleicht wird es ja DAS perfekte Match?

title: Staff Safety & Robotics Software Engineer (w/m/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und implementierst sicherheitskritische Lösungen für autonome Gabelstapler, die in Logistik- und Produktionsumgebungen eingesetzt werden
  • Du überführst Sicherheitskonzepte und Systemanforderungen in robuste Softwarearchitekturen, Safety-PLC-Lösungen und industrielle Steuerungssysteme
  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und wartest Softwarekomponenten für Robotersteuerung, Bewegungsregelung und autonome Fahrfunktionen
  • Du definierst und führst Verifikations- und Validierungsaktivitäten durch, einschließlich Integrations-, Fault-Injection- und Systemtests
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Functional-Safety-Experten, Systemarchitekten und Softwareentwicklern zusammen, um den sicheren und zuverlässigen Betrieb unserer Systeme sicherzustellen
  • Du agierst als Fachexperte für sicherheitskritische Software- und PLC-Entwicklung, unterstützt Kolleg:innen und förderst Engineering Best Practices im Unternehmen

Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Informatik, Robotik, Software Engineering oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets
  • Du bringst mindestens 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung sicherheitskritischer Software, industrieller Automatisierungssysteme, Robotikanwendungen oder Safety-PLC-Lösungen mit
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung mit industriellen Sicherheitssteuerungen oder Safety PLCs; Kenntnisse in Siemens S7 und TIA Portal oder SICK Flexi Soft/Flexi Net sind von großem Vorteil
  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Implementierung und Validierung von Sicherheitsfunktionen gemäß Normen wie ISO 13849, IEC 61508 oder IEC 62061
  • Du besitzt ein gutes Verständnis von Sicherheitskonzepten, Sicherheitsarchitekturen und anforderungsgetriebener Entwicklung
  • Du bist mit Verifikation, Validierung, Anforderungsnachverfolgbarkeit und V-Modell-basierten Entwicklungsprozessen vertraut
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Integration von Sensoren, Aktoren, industriellen Kommunikationssystemen und Feldbussen, idealerweise CANopen
  • Idealerweise bringst Du Kenntnisse in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche mit: SICK-Sicherheitslaserscanner, ROS-basierte Robotersysteme, C++- oder Python-Entwicklung, ros_control/ros2_control, Docker oder Motion-Control-Frameworks
  • Du legst Wert auf eine klare technische Dokumentation und den professionellen Umgang mit Versionsverwaltungssystemen
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B1)
  • Du arbeitest überwiegend vor Ort und wohnst idealerweise im Raum München oder bist bereit, regelmäßig vor Ort zu arbeiten.

Was wir bieten

  • Spitzentechnologie: Als Pioniere der Robotik sind wir in der Lage, ohne Schienen und Leitlinien zu navigieren und zu manipulieren, und bieten Lösungen für Prozesse, die noch nie jemand zuvor automatisieren konnte!
  • Team: Wir sind ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten. Du wirst in einem Team mit sehr smarten, bescheidenen, kooperativen und fleißigen Menschen arbeiten.
  • Kultur: Sei einfach Du selbst! Werde Teil eines dynamischen, innovativenund vielfältigen Teams, das Zusammenarbeit über Hierarchie stellt. Um innovativ zu sein, muss man ab und zu scheitern – wir lernen und verbessern uns ständig.
  • Vollverpflegung: Du hast keine Lust, darüber nachzudenken, was du morgen zu Mittag essen willst, geschweige denn, es vorzubereiten? Zum Glück verwöhnt uns unser französischer Koch jeden Tag mit einem frisch gekochten kostenlosen Mittagessen! Und als Sahnehäubchen gibt es einen gefüllten Kühlschrank mit Getränken, frischem Obst und natürlich Kaffee!
  • Flexibilität: Flexibilität wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Unser hybrides Arbeitsmodell für Positionen, bei denen Anwesenheit verzichtbar ist, trägt zu einer gesunden Work-Life-Balance bei.
  • Benefits: Wir bieten attraktive Urlaubs‑, Wellpass‑, Gesundheits- und Vergütungsleistungen. Erfahre hier mehr über unsere aktuellen Benefits.

Für uns bei Jungheinrich Robotics ist die Förderung der Inklusion sehr wichtig. Wir sind daher bestrebt, ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Kandidaten zu schaffen und bieten allen qualifizierten Bewerbern unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Alter, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Kultur oder Bildung gleiche Chancen. Wenn Du gewisse Anpassungen benötigst, um den Rekruitingprozess für Dich zugänglich zu machen, werden wir unser Bestes tun, um Dir entgegenzukommen. Sprich uns gerne darauf an!
