title: Staff Safety & Robotics Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Your tasks

  • You develop and implement safety-critical solutions for autonomous forklift robots operating in logistics and production environments
  • You translate safety concepts and system requirements into robust software architectures, Safety PLC implementations, and industrial control systems
  • You design, implement, and maintain software components across robot control, motion control, and low-level autonomy functions
  • You define and execute verification and validation activities, including integration, fault-injection, and system-level testing
  • You collaborate closely with functional safety experts, system architects, and software engineers to ensure safe and reliable system operation
  • You act as a technical expert for safety-critical software and PLC development, driving engineering excellence and mentoring colleagues

Requirements

  • You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Robotics, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • You bring 6+ years of professional experience in safety-critical software development, industrial automation, robotics, or Safety PLC solutions
  • You have strong experience with industrial safety controllers or Safety PLCs; experience with Siemens S7 and TIA Portal or SICK Flexi Soft/Flexi Net is highly desirable
  • You have proven experience implementing and validating safety functions according to standards such as ISO 13849, IEC 61508, or IEC 62061
  • You have a solid understanding of safety concepts, safety architectures, and requirements-driven development
  • You are familiar with verification, validation, requirements traceability, and V-model-based development processes
  • You have experience integrating sensors, actuators, industrial communication systems, and field buses, ideally CANopen
  • You ideally bring experience with SICK safety laser scanners, ROS-based robotics systems, C++ or Python development, ros_control/ros2_control, Docker, or motion-control frameworks
  • You enjoy creating clear technical documentation and working with version control systems
  • You communicate fluently in English and have German language skills at B1 level or higher
  • You are willing to work primarily on-site and ideally live in or close to Munich

What we have to offer

  • Cutting-edge technology: As pioneers in robotics we are able to navigate and manipulate without rails and guides and offer solutions to processes that no one could automate ever before!
  • Team: We are an international team with more than 25 nationalities. You’ll work in a team with exceptionally smart, humble, collaborative and hardworking individuals.
  • Culture: Come as you are! Join a vibrant, inventive, and diverse team that values collaboration over hierarchy. To innovate you need to fail from time to time — we always learn and improve.
  • Full Board: You don’t feel like thinking about what you want to have for lunch tomorrow, not to mention preparing it? Luckily, our french cook treats us with a freshly cooked free lunch everyday! And as the cherry on top, there is a packed fridge with drinks, fresh fruits and of course coffee!
  • F lexibility: Flexibility is a top priority for us. Our hybrid working model for positions where presence is dispensable helps to achieve a healthy work-life balance.
  • Benefits: We offer attractive holiday, health care, Wellpass and compensation packages. Learn more about our current benefits here.

We are dedicated to create an inclusive environment for all candidates and provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, national origin, sexual orientation, culture, or education. description:
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a Senior IT Project Manager to support a large-scale digital transformation programme within Germany's public healthcare sector. The programme focuses on acute and emergency care digitalisation, including cross-sector care, telemedicine, emergency assessment (SmED), eAppointment services, and the integration of emergency control centres.

Tasks

  • Lead multiple sub-projects in parallel within the acute and emergency care programme.
  • Build or adapt a stable, flexible and integrated IT service architecture that enables the changed business processes, with explicit service targets on cost and benefit, user acceptance, scalability, and compliance with information security and data protection requirements.
  • Run tender and procurement processes and manage external providers.
  • Maintain continuous alignment with business stakeholders, the programme management function, and external project partners.
  • Create the conditions for permanent operation and support of the IT services, including enabling internal IT staff and end users.

Requirements

  • German at native or full professional level. All project work, stakeholder communication and the selection interview are conducted in German.
  • 5+ years of experience leading complex IT projects with high integration requirements, working across both business and IT stakeholders.
  • 2–5 years of experience within the German public healthcare sector (e.g. physicians' associations, emergency care, statutory health insurance, telematics, emergency dispatch or related organisations).

title: Senior Fire, Health and Safety Consultant
description:
Senior Fire, Health & Safety Consultant | Hybrid | London & Surrounding | Permanent | Competitive Package

 

At Ark Workplace Risk, we empower our clients to confidently manage risk, compliance, and safety through a trusted partnership built on expert knowledge, innovative solutions, and proactive guidance and insight.  

 

About Ark Workplace Risk:  

  • Proven Expert Knowledge: With over 30 years of experience and a trusted reputation among 200+ UK organisations, we provide workable solutions that align with our clients' organisational and business goals, as well as regulatory requirements.  
  • Industry-Leading Software: Our innovative tools streamline risk and compliance management, putting clients in control and enabling them to demonstrate accountability to stakeholders.  
  • Insight-Driven Solutions: As industry thought leaders, we provide actionable insights into emerging legislation, guidance, and industry trends, ensuring court-readiness for their business.

About the Role  

 

Reporting into a Team Leader (each team is circa 5-7) and up to the Director of Professional Services, you will be joining a market leading team of professionals to undertake risk assessments and advise on fire, health and safety matters at a variety of buildings including mid-high rise buildings, to our established portfolio of clients across a variety of segments, including, residential, commercial and retail.  

 

Responsibilities:  

  •  Undertake risk assessments including fire and health and safety, ensuring the fee earning target is met.   
  • Undertake various fire, health and safety assignments within your competency.  
  • Deliver client reports within the agreed SLA, in accordance with a forensic and pragmatic approach to ensure the Ark 'Gold Standard' is achieved.   
  • Design health and safety site management systems where required, specific to client requirements.  
  • Undertake onsite briefings and advise on risk management improvements.  
  • Work collaboratively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.  
  • Work with other consultants to ensure we are constantly sharing knowledge across the team.  
  • Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of controlling risks, compliances etc in relation to our online management system QUOODA®  
  • Remain up-to-date with the Technical and regulatory requirements impacting our clients.    

  

The ideal candidate will have:  

  •  At least 5+ years' fire, health & safety risk assessment experience within the built environment in residential and/or commercial buildings 
  • Good working knowledge of Approved Document B 
  • Good working knowledge of BS 9999 / 9997 
  • Education suitable to be competent to carry out Fire and Health & Safety risk assessments on seven or more floors 
  • The ability to undertake Fire Risk Assessments and General Risk Assessments at the same time 
  • Articulate and clear communicators and report writing abilities as well as a comprehensive understanding of current UK regulations 

 

 Qualifications 

  • Must have NEBOSH General Certificate in Health & Safety or equivalent as minimum. 
  • Recognised fire safety memberships e.g. AIFireE, MIFireE, GIFireE, MIFSM or MIFPO (ADVANTAGEOUS) 
  • Willing to apply for or have registered on any of the following fire risk assessors registers IFSM, FRACS, IFPO or IFE 

 

Why Work for Us  

 

Ark is a market leader providing an innovative suite of; Professional Service Solutions, Outsourcing and future-proofed Software and Analytics to mid/major organisations in the UK. With over 500 global and premium brands trusting Ark to deliver smarter Risk, Compliance, Safety. 

 

Reasons to join for us:

  • An attractive package and training bursary contract.
  • New game changing Building Safety software. 
  • Options to mentor others and management progression within Ark. 
  • Progress your career with continuous training and CPD opportunities. 
  • Ark is an innovative growing company that is recognised as a leader in safety within the built environment. 
  • Ark organises technical and knowledge sharing which is of enormous benefit to the Ark Professional Services Team.

description:

What you will be doing:

  • Establish OLIVER/BrandTech Group's definitive POV on social media measurement for modern brands: what matters in 2026 and beyond, how to connect social activity to business outcomes, and what a mature measurement framework looks like.

What you need to be great in this role:

Deep hands-on experience across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Twitter/X, Snapchat, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms. Expert understanding of algorithms, content formats, audience behaviors, and native analytics. Proven experience with social listening platforms (Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Talkwalker, Pulsar). Social-native-fluent in internet culture, memes, subcultures, and how trends emerge online. 
  • Advanced Measurement & Technical Skills: Track record designing measurement frameworks, attribution models, and success metrics aligned to business objectives. Advanced Excel skills. Expert with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI). Experience with multi-touch attribution, marketing mix modelling, or statistical approaches for social measurement. Familiarity incorporating AI/ML and predictive analytics into workflows. 
  • Strategic Leadership & Client Advisory: Exceptional ability to advise senior stakeholders, translating data into business recommendations. Significant experience presenting complex insights with clarity and impact. Track record for building and mentoring analytics teams. Strong cross-functional collaboration with creative, strategy, and technology teams. Experience supporting new business development and articulating analytics capabilities in pitch situations.

title: People & Culture Coordinator
description:
About the Role:

TALA, known for activewear that keeps up with busy lifestyles, has been on a rocket ship since its founding in 2019 by entrepreneur Grace Beverley. Powered by a highly engaged, largely organic social community, we’ve evolved into a digital‑first, multichannel women’s athleisure brand with a sophisticated growth and retention engine. In 2025, we accelerated our physical retail expansion with the opening of two London stores, Carnaby Street and Westfield White City, marking a major step in our long‑term brand and community strategy.

We’re looking for a People & Culture Coordinator to join our growing team, reporting directly to the People & Culture Manager. You’ll be the first point of contact for all people related queries across both Head Office and Retail, acting as a trusted, friendly and solutions-focused partner to the business. This role combines hands‑on People Operations with creative ownership, from internal events to culture‑building moments that shape the TALA employee experience.

Tasks

What you’ll be doing:

People Operations

  • Managing the full employee lifecycle, ensuring a seamless and engaging experience from onboarding to offboarding
  • Preparing and processing monthly payroll with accuracy and timeliness
  • Drafting and issuing employment contracts and supporting documentation
  • Maintaining and updating our HRIS to ensure data integrity and compliance
  • Coordinating employee benefits and supporting with benefit queries
  • Producing monthly People reports and insights for the business
  • Exit Interviews

Internal Comms

  • Creating and sharing fun, engaging team updates that reflect our TALA tone of voice

Internal Events

  • Owning our ‘Moments That Matter’ calendar, ensuring we recognise and celebrate key moments throughout the year
  • Planning and delivering monthly team socials
  • Coordinating our annual Summer Party and Christmas Party, bringing creativity and energy to each event

Talent

  • Partnering with hiring managers to create role profiles
  • Posting vacancies across job boards and managing candidate pipelines
  • Screening applications and coordinating interviews, ensuring a smooth and positive candidate experience

Other

  • Support the People & Culture manager with the execution of People Projects
  • Maintaining and updating People policies and guidelines, ensuring compliance and consistency
  • Workplace support

Requirements

What we’re looking for:

  • 1–2 years’ experience in a People Coordinator or similar People Operations role
  • Exceptional attention to detail, you’ll be handling lots of data, and accuracy is key
  • Comfortable managing sensitive information with discretion and confidentiality
  • HRIS experience, HiBob is a plus!
  • A creative eye and a passion for bringing ideas to life, this role goes beyond traditional People Ops. We’re looking for someone who can help shape our internal culture through fun, thoughtful comms and events that reflect TALA!

Benefits

What we can offer:

  • 25 days holiday a year plus bank holidays
  • Very generous employee discount after probation period
  • Nominated Friends & Family Discount
  • Clothing allowance spending gift
  • Class Pass or Gym Flex membership
  • Health Shield
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity pay
  • Charity fundraising match of up to £1,000

About us:

TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $350M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.

We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Senior Pharmacist Clinician at AIOS

We are building a world-class team.

At AIOS Tech (Bolt Pharmacy), we're building the world's first full-stack AI doctor. Right now it’s akin to assisted self-driving (and improving every day), so humans are still doing everything with AI assisting their workflows.

You’ll not only function as a Team Lead, but you’ll help provide feedback to the Product teams to improve the in-house software that you and your team uses each day. You understand that a great patient experience means all information needed to prescribe is collected on intake so patients don’t get stuck in back-and-forth messiness.

You’ll pick up complex, escalated patient situations and smoothly resolve them within minutes, not hours, never compromising on safety or accuracy.

You’ll make sure every prescriber on your team is working through an appropriate number of tickets, and accuracy is never a concern.

You’ll:

  • Deliver safe, evidence-based GLP-1 prescribing—for your own patients and for every patient your team touches

  • Take full accountability for the day-to-day clinical quality, safety and governance of your team

  • Set the clinical standard and lead from the front on the most challenging cases

  • Lead the rollout of new protocols, medicines and clinical technology across your team

Great performance in this role means growth is never constrained by clinical capacity, prescribing quality or governance gaps. If you nail this role, you’ll be a leading candidate for future senior Clinical hires.

This is a full-time, remote role.

You’ll report directly to Mobeen, our Interim Clinical Ops Lead.

You’ll also work most closely with:

  • Saim Dalvi (UK Clinical Lead)

  • Phuong Nguyen (Superintendent Pharmacist)

Key responsibilities

  • Leadership: Lead clinicians in a fast-moving, regulated telehealth environment, and set clear standards on prescribing quality, audit and escalation.

  • Escalations: Take the complex cases yourself - comorbidities, polypharmacy, off-label decisions - and turn them into better protocols and patient questionnaires by providing feedback to the Product team.

  • Set the Bar: Reinforce high standards, urgency, radical candour and zero tolerance for mediocrity within the org.

  • Team Performance: Run regular audits of prescribing quality and protocol compliance, investigate errors and near misses, and escalate serious safeguarding, regulatory or data-protection concerns fast. Make sure your team meets minimum rates.

  • Protocols: Translate new evidence and regulatory guidance into practical clinical process, contributing to refined protocols.

title: Field Event Manager, EMEA
description:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders & dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for a Field Event Manager based in London to build our presence across EMEA.

About the Role

This is our first dedicated field marketing hire in Europe. You will build the EMEA program from a near-blank page: deciding which markets matter first, what formats work in each, and how a fast-moving American AI infrastructure company earns credibility with European enterprise buyers who will not be rushed.

You own the regional program, not just its logistics. That means the strategic call about London versus Paris versus Amsterdam versus Munich, the choice between a hosted dinner and a conference presence, and the judgment about what a room of senior technical buyers in each market will actually attend. You will execute all of it to a high standard, often as the only marketing person in the country.

The operating reality matters here. You will work across time zones with an SF-based team, navigate local vendors and contracts, and handle the regulatory and cultural differences that make European field marketing distinct from a US playbook copied across the Atlantic.

Own the documented approach that future European hires will inherit: what works by market, vendor relationships, and the local knowledge that would otherwise live only in your head.

title: Member of Technical Staff (SWE/Product)
description:
About Aptura

We build the evaluation datasets and RL environments that make AI reliable in domains where mistakes are expensive: finance, healthcare, and legal. Our team designs expert-curated training data, calibrated rubrics, and verifiable task environments for AI labs and startups pushing the frontier of what models can do in regulated industries.

We're a small, lean, London based team that moves fast and takes the work seriously. Everyone contributes directly. Initiative is rewarded, and ownership is the default. If you want to shape how frontier AI learns to operate in the real world, we'd like to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Member of Technical Staff on our Software Engineering team, you will build the platform that powers how Aptura operates and scales — the annotation tooling, workflow systems, quality control pipelines, and internal infrastructure that sit behind every dataset and environment we ship.

Day to day, that looks like: designing expert task creation flows, building task assignment and review interfaces, writing the data pipelines that move outputs from domain experts into structured training sets, and integrating LLM-powered tooling directly into the product. Some days it's product engineering. Some days it's closer to infrastructure. The common thread is that the software you build is what lets a small team produce high-quality evaluation data at scale.

You'll be the person who makes the platform real. Decide what gets built, how it gets built, and set the standard for how we build as we grow.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own the core data annotation and workflow platform end to end — from task assignment and expert interfaces to quality control and dataset delivery

  • Design systems that support expert onboarding, task routing, review workflows, and QA at scale

  • Build and improve AI-integrated pipelines across the platform, including LLM-assisted annotation, automated checking, and model-in-the-loop workflows

  • Work directly with founders and domain operators to turn manual, bespoke processes into reliable, scalable software

  • Make strong product and engineering decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving situations — scoping, prioritising, and shipping without waiting for perfect specs

  • Help define how we build as a team: tooling choices, engineering standards, and product direction

Who We're Looking For

You will not be a good fit if you thrive in well-defined scopes and prefer a clear spec before moving. We are looking for people who are comfortable identifying what needs building, making a call, and shipping — often before the full picture is clear.

You will not be a good fit if you like to go deep on one technical area for an extended period. We are looking for people who are energised by moving across product, infrastructure, data systems, and AI tooling — sometimes all in the same week.

You will not be a good fit if you prefer to hand work off at the boundaries of your role. We are looking for people who want to own problems end to end, from the first conversation through to something live.

You will not be a good fit if you aren't yet integrating AI into how you build day to day. We are looking for people who are already using LLMs and coding agents as part of how they work, and are excited to push that further.

You will not be a good fit if you think of speed and quality as things you trade off against each other. We are looking for people who don't cut corners — they cut scope.

We don't care about background, experience, or prestige. We want people who can demonstrate they will work hard, learn fast, and ship things that matter. Former founders, early engineers at startups, and people with infrastructure experience are a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building internal tools, annotation platforms, workflow software, or operations-heavy products

  • Familiarity with modern product stacks: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, FastAPI, or similar

  • Exposure to AI products, LLM tooling, or evaluation workflows

  • Domain interest in finance, healthcare, or legal

  • Previous experience as an early or founding engineer

On-site in London. Compensation (salary + equity) will be competitive.
